name: withheld-render-mounts-through-the-read
description: SPEC §7.10.6: under the read-plane-only posture a committed render's result publishes the view's identity only — the render locator on structuredContent.resourceUri and the same value on _meta.ui.resourceUri (and on the legacy flat _meta['ui/resourceUri'] when present) — and carries neither the ai.ggui/render slice nor a live-channel token anywhere. A resources/read of that published locator then returns contents that declare a delivery channel.
